start.text: Where Ness stood at the edge of the light there's nobody. Her cinder-rake leans on the shelter, the handle worn pale where her hands went. They've left everything they carried up.
Where Ness stood at the edge of the light there's nobody, and her rake's gone with her. They've left everything else they carried up.
Lost is when you go looking, she said. Gone.
The cresset you lit burns on past the shelter, up the road. Nobody turns their face from it now.
The doused cresset burns on past the shelter. Its stone has been set down square on the cairn, the way a Keeper sets a thing down, and a taper-end lies in the coals. You didn't light it.
You asked them not to. It's written down.
